records.text: Candace Owens said she believed chicken feed had been poisoned, questioned whether Perdue was the company involved, and claimed the pharmaceutical industry controls chicken feed.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: There was also a story years ago about how they had poisoned the chicken feed, which I totally believe happened, and all of these hens were not laying. ... when we looked behind the company that was behind it, it was like Perdue, wasn't it? Am I just thinking it's Perdue because it's Perdue chicken? You— I don't know. ... the point is, is that it was Big Pharma, which even controls what the chickens eat.

verification.notes: The transcript accurately preserves Owens's belief and uncertainty, but experts and state feed officials found no evidence of deliberately poisoned feed causing the 2023 egg decline. Perdue is a family-owned food and agriculture company; no evidence supports pharmaceutical-industry control.

records.text: Candace Owens said doctors should be imprisoned for the drugs prescribed to Lindsay Clancy and accused Big Pharma of getting away with responsibility for the deaths of Clancy's three children and the destruction of her life.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: There are a fleet of doctors who should be imprisoned for what they put her on. I regularly speak out against big pharma. ... They get away with murder all the time. And in this case, they are getting away with the murder of really her three children, but also completely destroyed. ... Destroyed her life.

verification.notes: Corrects an attribution-only true rating. Current trial reporting documents contested treatment and medication evidence, not established criminal liability of clinicians or pharmaceutical companies for the children's deaths. Owens's demand for imprisonment is a normative position, and the causal/criminal accusation is unproven by the evidence obtained.

records.text: Candace Owens said Lindsay Clancy had been taking a cocktail of 10 pharmaceuticals.
records.speaker: Candace Owens

appearances.snippet: the cocktail of 10 pharmaceuticals that she was on is absolute madness.

verification.notes: The episode confirms Owens said Clancy was on a cocktail of 10 pharmaceuticals. Current court-record reporting says Clancy was prescribed 13 psychiatric medications over four months, while toxicology from the day identified four prescription medications in her blood. That establishes extensive prescribing but does not support 10 drugs taken concurrently; the exact 'cocktail of 10 she was on' formulation is therefore only partially supported.
